# FunctionalMemoryTopology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The mapping between the topology of interconnections and the system's ability to store and retrieve functional information. Guides the design of interconnect topologies that maximize memory retention in distributed computing architectures.
